d.ko: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.

d.zh: 一款程序化的合作太空沙盒游戏，玩家可以用动态可伸缩的方块建造自己的太空舰船。经历史诗般的太空战斗、探索、采矿、交易、发起战争、建立自己的帝国，从未知敌人的手中拯救你的宇宙。

A Mix of Minecraft meets EVE, but offline. Build your own ships from blocks, place the turrets where you want, Make your ship a massive battleship with 30 cannons, make it high tech and fast with a lot of shields for scouting, build …

It's a shame this game has nearly been abandoned developmentally. Hands down one of the most all encompassing space games ever made. Non-linear yet goal orientated. Immersive gameplay in a giant universe.
It doesn't have modelled or simulated trade. It's mostly static and completely predictable. Why do much of the game is dedicated to trade makes no sense, when there isn't simulation for it. …
<Avorion>中文名叫 艾沃里翁 自带官中的沙盒飞船模拟游戏，可以多人也能单机，非常棒。 可以当成我的世界太空版，反正看着都是方块。 玩起来其实像我的世界版X系列。 玩家操控的永远是飞船，飞船毁了也是简单的无人机回到中立区域。 …
玩之前我对它的印象一直是：3d版cosmoteer、方块化space engineer、更自由但沉浸感和飞行体验不怎么样的ED+X4。打折入了说实话也没抱太多期待。 但一上手立马意识到我错了。这其实是太空版Terratech啊。 …
在经历了b站，贴吧，黑盒等一系列的教程，删游戏重下，重启电脑，重启steam和任务管理器把后台的某个物品关掉，我最终还是并非能完成对制作组留下的单人游戏实例未响应的大boss讨伐，制作组做出了一款我玩单机玩不了的游戏
